planName: Jujutsu Trunk-Based High-Velocity Pipeline in Workcell
summary: Implement the Jujutsu trunk-based high-velocity pipeline in Workcell. Transition the build lifecycle from an intermediate GitHub PR model to true Jujutsu (jj) trunk-based development with zero network roundtrip local handoffs and single remote CI gating. Update agents/handoff.md to formally specify local changeId handoff in anvil.agent-handoff/v1. Update agents/bodies/builder.md and agents/bodies/integrator.md to restrict builder verification strictly to sealed acceptance tests (~5s), eliminate intermediate GitHub branch pushes and PR creation, and empower the integrator to instantly combine wave changes onto the integration trunk in ~50ms via jj rebase -s <changeId> -d <integration-trunk> and execute the full test suite (scripts/run-tests.sh + linters) once on the combined wave state. Update .github/workflows/ci.yml to add Go build cache (~/.cache/go-build) and Python pip dependency caching, accelerating remote CI runs from ~3.5m to ~1m. Update skills/build/SKILL.md and skills/build/tests/test_build.py to codify trunk-based wave integration and builder test scoping while maintaining 100% of wave-loop and single-PR invariant assertions. Synchronize updated skills and agent definitions across all 4 harness replicas (claude, codex, agy, grok) via scripts/sync-skills.py and scripts/sync-agents.py.

architecture.changeSummary: Transition Workcell from per-issue GitHub PR pushes and remote CI bottlenecks to Jujutsu trunk-based development with single remote CI gating. Builders verify strictly scoped sealed acceptance tests in isolated jj workspaces, commit locally, and hand off anonymous change IDs. Integrators rebase wave changes locally in 50ms and execute the full project test suite once. Only the final milestone PR to main is pushed to GitHub, gated by an accelerated, cached GitHub Actions CI workflow.

issues.title: Update agent handoff contract and builder/integrator bodies for local trunk handoff
issues.body: Update agents/handoff.md, agents/bodies/builder.md, and agents/bodies/integrator.md. Formally add changeId to the anvil.agent-handoff/v1 schema and dispatch/handoff examples, documenting that builders commit changes locally in their isolated Jujutsu workspace via `jj describe -m '...'` and return their local changeId, setting pr to null. In agents/bodies/builder.md, strictly scope builder testing to run ONLY the sealed acceptance test via `tdd-guard verify --green-command ...` (~5s), explicitly forbidding broad discovery suites or whole-project test runners (scripts/run-tests.sh); eliminate `jj git push` and intermediate PR creation (`gh pr create`); update workspace teardown to happen after local changeId handoff is complete. In agents/bodies/integrator.md, document rebasing builder changes onto the integration trunk using `jj rebase -s <changeId> -d <integration-trunk>` (50ms zero network roundtrips) and executing full project test verification (scripts/run-tests.sh + linters) ONCE per combined wave state. Run python3 scripts/sync-agents.py to propagate changes across all agent definitions.

issues.title: Accelerate GitHub Actions CI with Go build and Python pip caching
issues.body: Update .github/workflows/ci.yml to optimize remote gating and build speeds. Configure dependency caching across CI jobs: add Go build cache (~/.cache/go-build) caching via actions/cache alongside the existing Go module cache in setup-go, and add Python pip dependency caching (via actions/setup-python cache: 'pip' or actions/cache for pip dependencies). Ensure workflow triggers are scoped to direct pushes to main and pull requests targeting main, preventing intermediate branch pushes from running redundant remote CI runs. Validate YAML syntax and verify that cached CI runs target reducing end-to-end execution from ~3.5 minutes to ~1 minute.

issues.title: Transition build skill to Jujutsu trunk-based pipeline and harmonize contract tests
issues.body: Update skills/build/SKILL.md to eliminate intermediate GitHub branch pushes and intermediate pull requests (gh pr create, gh pr checks --watch, gh pr merge --rebase). In skills/build/SKILL.md: (1) specify that builders commit locally in isolated jj workspaces (jj describe) and hand off changeId; (2) instruct builders to run ONLY their sealed acceptance test (tdd-guard verify --green-command ...) in ~5s, strictly forbidding broad test suites or discovery suites; (3) document that the integrator uses `jj rebase -s <changeId> -d <planId>-integration` to instantly combine wave changes onto the integration trunk in 50ms with zero network roundtrips; (4) document that the integrator runs the full project test suite (scripts/run-tests.sh + linters) ONCE on the combined wave state; (5) specify that only the final milestone integration PR targeting main is pushed to GitHub and triggers remote CI. Strictly preserve all existing wave loop contract phrases checked by test_skill_contracts.py and test_build.py: `closed **and** (`status:done` or `state_reason == completed`)`, `skills/build/scripts/waves.py`, `## Single-PR mode`, `<planId>-integration`, `final PR from the integration branch to `main``, `combined GREEN`, `never dispatch a builder for an issue with no seal`, `sole completion authority`, `wiki.py record`, `--kind build-wave`, `wiki.py status --repo .`, `tdd-guard reseal --reason`, `` `mode: refactor` ``, `` `mode: baseline` ``. Update skills/build/tests/test_build.py (specifically test_every_harness_builder_publishes_the_jj_workspace_lifecycle) to verify the new local trunk handoff lifecycle (local commit jj describe, local changeId handoff, zero intermediate push/PR) while verifying that all skill invariants in test_skill_contracts.py pass cleanly.

issues.body: Run python3 scripts/sync-skills.py and python3 scripts/sync-agents.py to synchronize the updated build skill (skills/build) and agent definitions (builder, integrator) across all four harness replicas (claude, codex, agy, grok). Verify that python3 scripts/sync-skills.py --check and python3 scripts/sync-agents.py --check report zero drift across all 16 skills and 10 agents. Verify that python3 scripts/check-contract-parity.py and python3 scripts/check-harness-bodies.py pass without errors.

risks.title: Modifying skills/build/SKILL.md breaks wave loop or single-PR contract assertions in test_build.py or test_skill_contracts.py
risks.mitigation: Preserve all required contract phrases (`closed **and** (`status:done` or `state_reason == completed`)`, `skills/build/scripts/waves.py`, `## Single-PR mode`, `<planId>-integration`, `final PR from the integration branch to `main``, `combined GREEN`, `never dispatch a builder for an issue with no seal`, `sole completion authority`, `wiki.py record`, `--kind build-wave`, `wiki.py status --repo .`) and run test_skill_contracts.py as an immediate verification gate.

risks.title: Updating builder lifecycle to eliminate intermediate PR pushes causes test_every_harness_builder_publishes_the_jj_workspace_lifecycle in test_build.py to fail
risks.mitigation: Concurrently update test_build.py to assert the new trunk-based builder lifecycle (jj workspace list, tdd-guard verify, Prove it runs, not just passes, at most two passes, jj describe, local handoff) rather than expecting jj git push.

risks.title: Incorrect cache keys in .github/workflows/ci.yml cause cache churn or failed module resolution
risks.mitigation: Use standard hashFiles patterns (go.sum, setup.py/requirements) for Go build cache and Python pip cache, test workflow syntax with yamllint or GitHub CLI, and verify fallbacks.

risks.title: Harness skill and agent replicas fall out of sync with canonical shared sources
risks.mitigation: Run python3 scripts/sync-skills.py and python3 scripts/sync-agents.py, then verify with --check across all 4 harnesses before wave completion.
